title: Artemisitene induces apoptosis of breast cancer cells by targeting FDFT1 and inhibits the growth of breast cancer patient-derived organoids.
authors: Chen, Dong; Li, Guangxin; Luo, Lianxiang; Lin, Tengyu; Chu, Xinyu; Liu, Kangdi; Lai, Tianli; Liao, Yinglin; Lin, Xian; Chen, Jian
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究青蒿素烯靶向FDFT1诱导乳腺癌凋亡，虽含分子对接/MD和ChIP，但核心是药物-蛋白互作及信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与TF-DNA课题关联微弱。
abstract: Artemisitene (ATT) is a natural bioactive compound with anti-breast cancer activity. However, the direct target and clinical efficacy of ATT on breast cancer are still unclear. The current study aimed to identify the target protein and underlying mechanism of ATT in anti-breast cancer. Moreover, patient-derived organoids (PDOs) were employed to assess the clinical efficacy of ATT on breast cancer. Herein, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA) combined with Western blot, surface plasmon resonance (SPR) were applied to confirm the interactional target of ATT in breast cancer cells. Bioinformatics analysis, Western blot, flow cytometry, plasmid construction and lentivirus infection, chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP) assay, and quantitative real-time PCR (RT-qPCR) were performed to reveal the potential mechanism of ATT in treating breast cancer. PDOs were established to evaluate the clinical therapeutic efficiency of ATT on breast cancer. We found that ATT interacted with Farnesyl-diphosphate farnesyltransferase 1 (FDFT1) in breast cancer cells. Knockdown of FDFT1 induced NEDD4 expression and apoptosis in breast cancer cells. Overexpression of FDFT1 could rescue ATT-induced apoptosis, while interfering with FDFT1 expression decreased the level of RelA (NF-kappaB p65 subunit) in the nucleus in breast cancer cells. Knockdown of FDFT1 induced NEDD4 expression by regulating TNFR1/NF-kappaB pathway. Overexpression of FDFT1 could reverse the activation of ATT-induced TNFR1/NF-kappaB/NEDD4 pathway in breast cancer cells. Interestingly, the ChIP assay and RT-qPCR revealed that p65 could regulate NEDD4 transcription. Furthermore, ATT exhibited a broad-spectrum inhibitory effect on the growth of breast cancer PDOs with different pathological subtypes, and showed an excellent safety profile in comparison with that of conventional chemotherapy drugs. In summary, this work demonstrated that ATT targets FDFT1 to induce apoptosis of breast cancer cells through regulating TNFR1/NF-kappaB/NEDD4 pathway and suppresses breast cancer PDOs growth, which supported ATT as an effective and potential drug candidate for breast cancer treatment.
abstract_zh: 蒿甲素（Artemisitene, ATT）是一种具有抗乳腺癌活性的天然生物活性化合物。然而，ATT在乳腺癌中的直接靶点及临床疗效仍不明确。本研究旨在鉴定ATT抗乳腺癌的靶蛋白及其潜在机制。此外，采用患者来源类器官（patient-derived organoids, PDOs）评估ATT对乳腺癌的临床疗效。本研究通过分子对接、分子动力学模拟、细胞热位移分析（cellular thermal shift assay, CETSA）结合Western blot、表面等离子体共振（surface plasmon resonance, SPR）确认ATT在乳腺癌细胞中的相互作用靶点。采用生物信息学分析、Western blot、流式细胞术、质粒构建和慢病毒感染、染色质免疫沉淀（chromatin immunoprecipitation, ChIP）分析及实时定量PCR（quantitative real-time PCR, RT-qPCR）揭示ATT治疗乳腺癌的潜在机制。建立PDOs以评估ATT对乳腺癌的临床治疗效率。我们发现ATT与乳腺癌细胞中的法尼基二磷酸法尼基转移酶1（Farnesyl-diphosphate farnesyltransferase 1, FDFT1）相互作用。敲低FDFT1诱导乳腺癌细胞中NEDD4表达和凋亡。FDFT1过表达可挽救ATT诱导的凋亡，而干扰FDFT1表达则降低乳腺癌细胞核中RelA（NF-kappaB p65亚基）的水平。敲低FDFT1通过调控TNFR1/NF-kappaB通路诱导NEDD4表达。FDFT1过表达可逆转ATT诱导的乳腺癌细胞中TNFR1/NF-kappaB/NEDD4通路的激活。有趣的是，ChIP分析和RT-qPCR显示p65可调控NEDD4转录。此外，ATT对不同病理亚型的乳腺癌PDOs生长表现出广谱抑制作用，并与传统化疗药物相比显示出优异的安全性。总之，本研究证明ATT靶向FDFT1，通过调控TNFR1/NF-kappaB/NEDD4通路诱导乳腺癌细胞凋亡，并抑制乳腺癌PDOs生长，支持ATT作为乳腺癌治疗的有效且潜在候选药物。
